report: dirigo 0.2.13 port vs stock 0.2.13, same battery

hardware.gpu: Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GB (Battlemage G31, PCI 8086:e223), AOT target bmg-g31
hardware.display_gpu: AMD Raphael iGPU (1002:164e) drives the desktop; the Arc is compute-only
hardware.model: qwen3.8-flash-next-coder-iq1_m (Qwen3.8 coder, IQ1_M + mine expert pack)

what_was_measured.unit_suites: python -m unittest discover -s serve -p 'test_*.py' in each tree
what_was_measured.behaviour_probes: minefield (5 traps), 24-token short-answer extraction, needle at 7,855 tokens, 165,779-token over-window request, lever endpoints
what_was_measured.battery: bench_prefill (fresh 4.2k/8.8k + follow-ups, warmup) and longprobe (code, 30k prompt, 7.9k needle, over-window), two interleaved passes each, order dirigo stock stock dirigo
what_was_measured.guidellm: GuideLLM 0.8.1, synthetic_text 512 in / 128 out, concurrent profile streams 1,2,4,8, 45 s per point, one load round trip: dirigo then stock in the same session
what_was_measured.determinism: same greedy prompt repeated 10x (3 prompts) plus a 4.2k prompt 6x, both engines, counting distinct answers

fairness_notes: Both trees built with the same script, same flags, same pinned ggml, same AOT target; the two engine binaries differ by 8,616 bytes.
Both trees ran the same server config file contents; the stock server ignores the fork's lever keys (conv_route, thinking_policy, spec_window, code_tune) and 404s /v1/tuning and /v1/tune.

Each engine had the card to itself (the production service on :8095 was stopped for the duration and restored afterwards); every window verified 12,288 of 12,288 slots pre-filled with 0 experts over PCIe.
GuideLLM arms ran back to back in one session; position drift measured in the companion 0.2.12-vs-0.2.13 run is 2-4%, smaller than the differences reported here.
Speed numbers are one card, one model, one workload shape (512/128 concurrent and a 4-leg prefill/decode battery); they are not a claim about other hardware.

artifacts.guidellm/: raw GuideLLM result JSONs and summary.json
artifacts.determinism/: distinct-answer counts per prompt, both engines
artifacts.scripts/: the harnesses that produced all of the above
